reports.title: Farmers' Milk Value
reports.description: Each farmer's milk and its value for any dates, before deductions. Not for paying: pay from the pay run's Bank or M-Pesa list.

reports.title: Farmer Statement
reports.description: Every delivery by one farmer, with price and amount. To give to the farmer.

reports.title: Customer Statement
reports.description: One customer's sales and payments with the running balance. To send to the customer.

reports.title: Customers Owing
reports.description: Every customer who owes the Sacco money, largest first.

reports.title: Sacco Summary
reports.description: Day by day: milk in and out, cost of milk, sales revenue and margin, with totals.

reports.title: Deductions
reports.description: What pay runs took from farmers in the period: totals for each deduction (shares, fees, transaction cost…) and each farmer's.

reports.title: Farmer Balances
reports.description: Farmers who owe the Sacco (advances, charges, arrears) or are owed, with their shares.

reports.title: Income and Expenditure
reports.description: Milk sales and purchases, fees and charges, expenses by category and the surplus; with cash, debts and shares now.

reports.title: Expenses
reports.description: Every expense in the period with category, payee, account and reference, and totals by category.

reports.title: Cashbooks
reports.description: Money in and out of each account (petty cash, bank, M-Pesa) with running balances.

reports.title: Income Statement
reports.description: Income less expenses from the books for the period, beside the period before it.

reports.title: Balance Sheet
reports.description: What the Sacco owns and owes at the end of the period, beside its start.

reports.title: Trial Balance
reports.description: Every account's balance at the end of the period, debits and credits in their columns.

reports.title: General Ledger
reports.description: Every account's entries in the period with opening and closing balances.

reports.title: Journals
reports.description: Every journal line in the period (date, journal, account code, debit, credit, memo): to import into other accounting software.

reports.title: Chart of Accounts
reports.description: Every account with its code, kind and balance today.

reports.title: Farmer Register
reports.description: All farmers with contacts, payout details, next of kin and status.
